name: ultrathink-protocol
description: Root-cause investigation protocol for live, complex or multi-layer technical problems. Use when a problem has resisted two or more fix attempts, the root cause is unknown or assumed, you are about to retry a variation of a failed fix, or the user says "ultrathink protocol", "think deeper", "figure out why", "stop guessing", "find the root cause", or "it's still broken after your fix". Also use proactively when about to write a fix before the cause is verified. Once the incident is resolved and a write-up is wanted, use rca-report instead.
